about: Java starting code with a list choice: the forms split by a line that is exactly '// choice: Name', the text before the first marker shared by every form. 'shared' is the text before the first marker, each form's 'code' the lines after its marker up to the next one, both kept byte for byte. A case with an 'error' is refused at save with that sentence (Go); the editor then sees one plain form with no choice (TypeScript). A case with no markers has one form with no name. Only Java is read, so a marker in another language is ordinary text. Read by the Go test on problems.SplitStarter and by the editor's splitStarter, so the two cannot drift.
